title: One community full-info fetch is held in three places: the community_full_infos map, CommunitiesState::full_info_failed and the in-flight request purpose
trigger: getCommunityFullInfo fails; want_community_full_info reads the failed set, get_community_full_info reads the map and the request table; the set is cleared only by three reducer sites when TDLib sends news
effect: No bug today; Loading is not a value, so a failure for a community that is then deleted leaves its id in the set
fix: Fetch<CommunityFullInfo> per community id

title: refresh_forum_topics removes the cached list, then a getForumTopics already in flight makes the refetch a no-op
trigger: Create, rename, pin or delete a topic from the manage dialog while the first getForumTopics for that chat is still in flight
effect: The refresh asks nothing; the older answer fills the list with the state from before the change
fix: A refresh marks the entry stale so the answer of the earlier request is followed by a new request

title: maybe_probe_channel_membership re-sends getMe from the poll pump after every failed answer
trigger: my_user_id is still unknown, a channel or supergroup is open, getMe answers with an error (no handler for RequestPurpose::GetMe errors in the reducer)
effect: probe_membership_everywhere runs every pump and sends a new getMe each time it finishes, an unbounded retry loop while the chat stays open, with the composer gate unresolved
fix: A Fetch for the account's own user with a Failed variant that is retried by an explicit retry or after a backoff

title: NewChatCreation holds its stage as CreationAsker::{Dialog, Closed} beside outcome: Option<CreationOutcome> and a one-shot photo Option
trigger: abandon_new_chat flips asker by hand from the UI; capture_new_chat and run_new_chat_created each remove or keep the entry depending on asker and outcome
effect: No bug today; an entry whose dialog never calls abandon_new_chat stays in the map for the session
fix: enum Creation { Waiting{asker, photo}, Answered{asker, outcome}, Settled } removed in one place

title: full_rich_loads holds Loading with request None and is written after the send; the answer is matched by chat+message purpose, not the RequestId
trigger: Press Load full message on a partial rich message; a second caller of fetch_full_rich_message (the driver has no in-flight guard, only the UI disables the button) sends a second request
effect: Two requests can be in flight for one key; the first answer removes the Loading entry while the second is still out, and the button re-enables early. No bug today because the only caller disables the button while loading
fix: Insert Fetch::Loading { request: Some(extra) } before the send, skip when one is already loading, and settle by the held RequestId

title: add_chat_members in a basic group returns Ok when a send after the first fails, so the rest are silently not added
trigger: Add several people to a basic group while the sender refuses the second addChatMember
effect: The loop breaks, returns Ok(first request), no add_members_failed count is recorded for the unsent users, and the box reports success for people who were never added
fix: Record the unsent user count as failed members (or return the error with the partial result) instead of break then Ok

title: A refused refetch of a privacy rule replaces the held rule with Failed
trigger: Open a Privacy page that already holds a rule (Ready), then fetch_privacy_rules again with sends refused: begin_privacy_load turns Ready into Loading, the send fails, insert(key, Failed) drops the rule detail
effect: The row shows 'could not load' with no value, though the last known rule was valid (Fetch::fail keeps stale data; PrivacyKeyState::Failed does not)
fix: Restore the previous state (or Failed carrying the held detail) when the send is refused

title: A failed send of the notification-exceptions fetch removes the entry, so the Notifications page render asks again
trigger: Close the client (send refused), open Settings > Notifications: maybe_fetch_notification_exceptions removes the Loading entry on a refused send; notifications_page (ui/settings_window/notifications.rs:46) calls it on every render
effect: Each redraw builds and sends the request again while sends are refused; no Failed stage ends the ask (Retry exists only for a TDLib error)
fix: On a refused send, leave the scope in Fetch::Failed (as for a TDLib error) so only Retry re-asks

title: DeviceLogin::{Idle,InFlight} is a twin of sessions_op's mutating stage for the same request
trigger: Confirm a device-login QR; sessions_op.begin(id) and device_login=InFlight are set together and cleared in three arms (send error, answer, error answer) by hand
effect: Sessions buttons are gated by sessions_busy() = sessions_op.is_mutating() || device_login.in_flight(); the answer is matched by purpose (ConfirmDeviceLogin), not the RequestId, so the second stage adds nothing the first lacks and the two can drift
fix: Drop InFlight: the device link is a ListOp write with a result slot (Done(result)) keyed by the RequestId held in sessions_op

title: A refused getActiveSessions send returns the list to Idle, and the calls section asks again from render
trigger: Refuse sends, show a settings page with call_device_prefs_section: needs_fetch = sessions.is_idle(); maybe_fetch_active_sessions cancels back to Idle on a refused send
effect: Every render of the section spawns a task that builds and sends the fetch again (no redraw is requested, so it is wasted work per frame rather than a loop)
fix: Fetch::fail on a refused send; the section asks only from Idle

title: ToneUpload::Uploading holds a name and target but no RequestId; its answer is matched by purpose
trigger: Upload a notification tone; the answer or error is applied to settings.tone_upload when pending.purpose == UploadSavedNotificationSound
effect: One upload at a time is enforced by the Uploading check, but a late answer of any earlier UploadSavedNotificationSound request would settle the current upload (finish_tone_upload and apply_tone_upload_error never compare ids)
fix: Uploading { request: RequestId, name, target }, settled only when the answering id matches

title: activateStoryStealthMode says it is deduped while in flight but sends on every call
trigger: Press the stealth button twice quickly: no has_purpose check precedes session.request
effect: Two requests go out; the second answer's refusal (or success) replaces the first's stealth_refusal slot, so the box can show the wrong outcome
fix: has_purpose guard, or keep the RequestId in a stealth stage and refuse while it is out

title: Load<T> is Fetch<T> again, and its Loading holds no RequestId: ton/stars stats answers and errors are matched by peer
trigger: open a revenue page for peer A, close it, open A again (or change theme) while the first getChatRevenueStatistics/getStarRevenueStatistics is out
effect: state/domains/payments/earn.rs:85-120 and 486-516 apply any answer or error whose EarnPurpose peer equals page.peer, not the request the page waits for: a stale answer (old is_dark chart colors) or stale error (Failed + toast over a request still in flight) lands on the new page; PageLoad in the same page already keys by RequestId
fix: Fetch<T> with the RequestId in Loading (as PageLoad), compared in the answer and error arms

title: Withdraw::request duplicates the RequestId of WithdrawStep::PasswordSending and Checking has none of its own
trigger: Collect/Withdraw, wrong password, retry
effect: connect/earn.rs send_withdrawal writes withdraw.request, then submit_withdrawal_password writes step = PasswordSending(request) separately; takes_answer must compare both and a hand-set pair can drift (a step change that forgets request, or the reverse)
fix: each WithdrawStep variant that waits carries its own RequestId (Checking(RequestId), PasswordSending(RequestId)); drop Withdraw::request

title: SetupPage::confirm and SetupPage::saving are one stage (Idle/Confirming/Saving) kept in step by hand
trigger: Affiliate setup: Start/Update then confirm, or End then confirm
effect: end_starref_program clears confirm when the send leaves (connect/earn.rs:499-503) while save_starref_program keeps it open until the answer (comment: tdesktop keeps ConfirmUpdate); the two paths differ by hand and apply_earn_error clears saving only, so a failed End leaves no box and a failed Save leaves the box
fix: enum SetupStage { Editing, Confirming(SetupConfirm), Saving { kind, request } }

title: SetupPage keeps confirm: Option<SetupConfirm> and saving: Option<RequestId> as two options of one flow
trigger: Confirm Save sets confirm and the send sets saving; End sets confirm=None itself on a successful send, Save keeps it until the answer
effect: Two options that must stay in step (confirm Some while saving for Save, None while saving for End)
fix: enum SetupStage { Editing, Confirming(SetupConfirm), Saving{kind, request} }

title: Trending emoji sets paging is four loose fields plus a Fetch, kept in step by hand
trigger: Emoji Sets box, Trending tab, scroll to the end, a page fails or the catalog refreshes
effect: trending_offset (written before the send in connect/emoji_sets.rs:552), trending_next_offset and trending_has_more (state apply), trending_total (state/domains/stickers/apply.rs:143) and lists.trending (Fetch<()>) describe one paged list; a failed page leaves trending_has_more true so every scroll event asks again, and offset 0 doubles as 'replace the list' in accept_trending_emoji_sets; the earn lists solved the same shape with PageLoad
fix: a PageLoad-style enum { Unasked, Loading{request, more}, Ready{next_offset, total}, Failed } for the trending list

title: keyword_emojis and animated_emoji(+_for) hold no request and no stage: answers are matched by purpose and stale ones are dropped only by take_purpose
trigger: type in the emoji panel search or the composer faster than TDLib answers
effect: dispatch_emoji_payload (emoji/mod.rs:448-451) and accept_animated_emoji (:489-499) write on purpose alone; they are right only because search_keyword_emojis / update_animated_emoji_suggestion drop the older pending entry first; query/animated_emoji_for are set before the send and a failed answer leaves 'asked' with no way to tell loading from none
fix: Fetch<(String, Vec<String>)> / Fetch<Option<StickerItem>> keyed by the RequestId, compared in the answer arm

title: EmojiPanel::open mirrors DialogKind::EmojiSets (open_box) and is written from three places
trigger: open Emoji Sets, switch account, demo path
effect: the box is open when open_box(DialogKind::EmojiSets) AND emoji.open agree: ui/emoji_sets.rs:46-55 sets both, close_emoji_sets clears only the session flag, connect/emoji_sets.rs:348 and :592/:611 also read or set it; a Farewell closer exists (settings_state.rs:152) but only because the flag lives in the Session
fix: one open state owned by the dialog host (OnScreen), with the driver asking it instead of reading a Session bool

title: ExportView {Shown, Hidden} is the old `hidden: bool` kept on ChatExport/AccountExport beside the export's own Progress stage
trigger: user presses Hide on the export box, then export settles
effect: result shows as a note; visibility is a second field next to the stage rather than part of it
fix: fold into the export's stage (e.g. Running{boxed: Shown|Hidden}, Settled{noted}) so Done clears it with the stage

title: A timed-out worker call leaves WorkerLink::handoff in Awaiting, holding the single request slot
trigger: account export: one TDLib call exceeds QUERY_TIMEOUT (300 s); export_chats swallows the Tdlib error and goes on to the next chat
effect: every later call waits behind the abandoned request (pump_export only takes a request when idle_or_cancelled) and can time out too, so the remaining chats are counted as failed
fix: on timeout the worker tells the link to abandon (Handoff::Abandoned) so the slot frees, or the timeout ends the export

title: Non-test RefCell borrow()/borrow_mut() in LoadedFiles
trigger: none today: guards are short and nothing re-enters; Files::save and save_once call find then save
effect: would panic (BorrowMutError) if a future caller held a borrow across a call; panic-safety rule 6
fix: Cell-free cache owned by the worker (&mut) or try_borrow with fallback

title: CollectionsFetch::Loading carries no RequestId; settle() on any collections answer/error of an earlier owner ends the new owner's Loading
trigger: Open owner A's gifts list, switch to owner B's before A's getGiftCollections answers: reset_for_owner sets Idle, B's fetch sets Loading, A's late answer/error calls settle()
effect: B's collections look settled (Idle) while its request is out; Stale mark/refresh logic can send a duplicate
fix: Loading { request: RequestId } matched against the pending id

title: GiftFlow answers are matched by PaymentsPurpose, not by the request the flow sent
trigger: start Upgrade or Resale on gift A (request out, flow stays open), pick gift B and open the same kind of flow; A's ok lands
effect: B's confirmation box closes without the user answering it
fix: GiftFlow variants carry Sending(RequestId) once sent and close only on that id (like TransferStage::Transferring)

title: GiftManageState::deleting is a second marker of the in-flight deleteGift beside hub.gifts_op, with no RequestId
trigger: delete a gift; its ok or error lands
effect: the answer takes whatever id is in the slot (matched by purpose); only gifts_op.is_mutating keeps a second delete from overwriting it
fix: ListOp::Mutating{request, target} carrying the gift id, or GiftFlow::Deleting{id, request}

title: SendGiftState::open: bool beside recipient/stage: closed-with-send-in-flight is a state kept by hand
trigger: open the send box, press Send, close the box before the answer
effect: recipient/gifts stay while open=false so the answer can still notice; stage resets happen in close_send_gift, open_send_gift_to and the answers separately
fix: SendGiftBox::{Closed, Open(dialog), Sending{request, dialog, shown: Shown|Hidden}}

title: SendGiftState::open bool sits beside recipient/stage as the dialog's open stage
trigger: Send a gift and close or rebuild the dialog while sendGift is out
effect: apply_gift_manage_ok/error decide between the box line and a status notice from open, kept in step with recipient and stage by hand
fix: Option<SendGiftDialog> holding recipient, gifts and stage; closed is None

title: TransferStage::Probing carries no RequestId; the probe's answer or error is matched by purpose (GiftExportProbe)
trigger: open Fragment (probe 1 out), then another gifts list opens (reset_for_owner drops the picker), open a new picker and Open Fragment (probe 2); probe 1's late error lands
effect: picker 2 leaves Probing early for the password box or security check, probe 2's answer is then ignored
fix: TransferStage::Probing(RequestId) compared in apply_gift_export_probe_error/answer like ExportSend::Out
